description.en: Smilodon populator: whole-organism living environment prop. Nominal whole length 0.8m; tawny coat, soft anatomy, facial expression, paws, pose and exact saber exposure are art. Whole museum art/silhouette plus skull cast and curator text inform conservative populator identity; no whole skeleton-photo or scan claim.
